# Sea2Sky Traders

> Sea2Sky Traders (sea2skytraders.com) is an online store and exporter based in Lahore, Pakistan. It sells premium dry fruits, Himalayan pink salt, Pakistani rice and seasonal fresh fruits to homes, retailers, restaurants and importers in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the USA, the UK, Europe and Japan. Retail packs, luxury gift sets, bulk export packaging and private label are available.

Orders are placed through the website cart or on WhatsApp (+92 300 8697543). Prices on the website are in US dollars; final price, shipping cost and delivery time are confirmed on WhatsApp for each country.

## Shop
- [All products](https://sea2skytraders.com/shop.html): dry fruits, pink salt, rice and fresh fruits with prices
- [Dry fruits](https://sea2skytraders.com/shop.html?cat=dry-fruits): almonds, pistachios, cashews, walnuts, dates, raisins, Hunza dried apricots, gift boxes
- [Himalayan pink salt](https://sea2skytraders.com/shop.html?cat=pink-salt): fine and coarse salt, grinders, salt lamps, gift sets
- [Rice](https://sea2skytraders.com/shop.html?cat=rice): Super Kernel basmati, 1121 Sella and Steam basmati, 1509 basmati, brown basmati, PK-386, IRRI-6, broken rice, bulk export
- [Fresh fruits](https://sea2skytraders.com/shop.html?cat=fresh-fruits): Sindhri and Chaunsa mangoes, kinnow, apples, bananas, grapes (seasonal)

## Payment
PayPal, Visa and Mastercard (secure payment link), bank transfer, JazzCash and Easypaisa, and cash on delivery within Pakistan.
